description:
Create a 2-column technical datasheet for a new semiconductor product using Apache OpenOffice Writer. 

1. Read the product specifications from '/home/ga/Documents/product_specs.json'. 
2. Create a new document in OpenOffice Writer. 
3. Add the Product Title 'SE-9042 Low-Power IoT Transceiver' and the text 'Preliminary' at the top (full width). 
4. Format the main body (Description, Features, Applications) using a TWO-COLUMN layout. 
5. Insert a Table for the 'Electrical Characteristics' data. 
6. Add a Footer with the text 'SiliconEdge Solutions - Confidential'. 
7. Save the document as '/home/ga/Documents/SE9042_Datasheet.odt'.
